note: First-floor quantities room (4): totality, abundance, allocation, half a dozen, about sixty. Most nouns here are feminine, so the divider sits at x=940: feminine nouns to the left of it, masculine (trimestre, résidu, diplômé, quota, participe) to the right. The left door goes back to the adverbs of degree (2) room; the right door leads on to the adverbs of degree (3) room.
